questions.question: _________ was the chairman of the planning commission when the first five year plan was formulated in India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Jawaharlal Nehru.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru **was the **chairman** of the **planning commission **when the first five year plan was formulated in India. 
 
• This five-year plan was based on Harrod- Domer model of USSR.
 
• The first plan stressed more on Agriculture in the view of large scale import of food grain and other areas of emphasis were power and Transport
 
• The annual average growth rate during the first five-year plan was estimated as 3.61% as against a target of 2.1%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian politician, attorney, journalist, and scholar Rajendra Prasad** presided over India as its **first president** from **1950 to 1962.**
 
• **Indian nationalist Subhas Chandra Bose** became a hero to many Indians through his defiance of British rule in India.
 
 
• He was a leader of the **Indian National Congress,** a participant in the **noncooperation movement,** and a supporter of socialist policies.
 
• He belonged to the organization's **more militant wing.**
 
 
 
• From **1964 to 1966, Lal Bahadur Shastri, **an Indian politician and statesman, was the country's **second prime minister.**
 
 
• From** 1961 to 1963,** he held the position of** India's sixth home minister.**

questions.question: In the self-help group, the loan and saving decisions are taken by the __________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**group members.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In a **self-help group,** the **members **collectively take the decisions regarding **loans and savings.**
 
• The group members decide the** terms and conditions** of the **loan,** the **repayment schedule**, the** interest rate**, and the **purpose of the loan.**
 
• The** saving decisions** are also taken by the **group members**, such as the amount to be saved, the frequency of saving, and the purpose of saving.
 
• The self-help group model is based on the** principle of mutual trust and cooperation,** and the group members work together to meet their **financial needs.**
 
• The self-help group model has been successful in promoting** financial inclusion and empowering women** in rural areas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Non-government organizations (NGOs)** may provide support and training to self-help groups, but they **do not **make the loan and saving decisions.

 
 
• A non-governmental organization is one that, in most cases, is founded **without the involvement** of the government. 
 
 
 
• **Banks **may provide **loans to self-help groups,** but the terms and conditions of the loan are decided by the group members.
 
 
• A bank is a type of financial institution that lends money while also **taking deposits** from the general public and generating** demand deposits.**
 
 
 
• **Government agencies** may provide policy support and financial assistance to self-help groups, but they **do not** make the loan and saving decisions.
 
 
• A permanent or semi-permanent organization that is part of the political system and is in charge of** overseeing and carrying out** particular duties is known as a government or state agency.

questions.question: According to Kautilya's Arthashastra, the Commanding Officer of the cavalry in the Mauryan administration was known as:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwadhyaksha.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Kautilya's Arthashastra,** the **commanding** **officer of the cavalry **in the Mauryan administration was known as **Ashwadhyaksha.**
 
• The term 'Ashwa' means** horse** and 'dhyaksha' means **commander or supervisor.**
 
• The Ashwadhyaksha was responsible for **managing and training **the cavalry soldiers, selecting and breeding horses, and ensuring the proper maintenance of the horses and equipment.
 
• The cavalry played a crucial role in the **Mauryan army, **and the Ashwadhyaksha held an important position in the administration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the Mauryan administration, the war office was made up of** six boards.**
 
• **Rathadhyaksha** refers to the commander of the** chariots. **
 
 
• He was also in charge of **paying the workers** who were building chariots.​
 
 
 
• **Hastyadhyaksha **refers to the commander of the **elephants. **
 
• **Patyadhyaksha** refers to the commander of the **infantry.**

questions.question: Doongri festival of Himachal Pradesh is primarily celebrated by which religious community?

• The festival is marked by** processions, folk dances, and music performances.**
 
• The festival also features the **sacrifice of animals**, which is a controversial aspect of the celebration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Muslim community** in **Himachal Pradesh** celebrates festivals such as **Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha, and Muharram.**

questions.question: Which of the soluble fibres found in fruits is used as a thickener in cooking and baking?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pectin.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pectin** is a **soluble fiber** found in** fruits** that is commonly used as a** thickener in cooking and baking.**
 
• It is particularly useful for **making jams and jellies **as it helps to set the **fruit mixture.**
 
• Pectin is also used in the food industry as a **stabilizer and emulsifier,** and it is found in many processed foods such as **yogurt, ice cream, and salad dressings.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Lignin** is also a type of fiber found in fruits, but it is** not soluble in water** and therefore cannot be used as a thickener.

 
 
• Lignin is a significant **organic polymer** that is widely distributed in the **cell walls **of some particular cells.
 
• It performs a wide range of biological tasks, including the **movement of water, mechanical support, and resistance** to various stresses.
 
 
 
• **Cellulose** is another type of fiber found in fruits, but it is also **not soluble in water **and is not commonly used as a thickener in cooking and baking.
 
 
• All plant cell walls contain cellulose, an** insoluble dietary fiber** made of **glucose polymers**.
 
• Foods that contain cellulose include** leafy green vegetables** like **kale, Brussels sprouts, and green peas.**
 
 
 
• **Inulin** is a **soluble fiber** found in some fruits and vegetables, but it is** not** commonly used as a thickener in cooking and baking.
 
 
• It is often used as a** prebiotic to promote gut health.**
 
• In the stomach, it is **neither digested nor absorbed.**
 
• It persists in the bowel and promotes the growth of specific a**dvantageous bacteria. **

questions.question: 'Vazhuvoor' is one of the styles of which Indian classical dance form?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vazhuvoor** is a style of **Bharatanatyam,** which is a **classical dance form** originating from** Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• This style is named after the **village of Vazhuvoor,** which is known for its contribution to Bharatanatyam.
 
• Vazhuvoor style is characterized by its** graceful movements, intricate footwork**, and** emphasis on abhinaya **(expressional) aspects of the dance.
 
• Other styles of Bharatanatyam include** Pandanallur, Thanjavur, and Kalakshetra.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The traditional dance style from** Uttar Pradesh** is called **Kathak.**

 
 
• The dancer controls about **100 ankle bells **to produce the **intricate footwork and precise rhythmic patterns **that are distinctive to Kathak.
 
 
 
• **Kerala** is the region of southwest India where** kathakali **originated.
 
 
• Like bharatanatyam, kathakali is a **religious dance. **The** Ramayana **and tales from** Shaiva traditions** serve as its primary sources of inspiration.
 
 
 
• The state of** Kerala** is where the Indian classical dance style known as **mohiniyattam **was born and has since flourished. 
 
 
• The word "**Mohini,"** the feminine form of **Lord Vishnu**, is the source of the name "**Mohiniyattam,"** which translates to "**dance of Mohini."**

questions.question: Who was the Mughal emperor during the third battle of Panipat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Shahalam II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Mughal emperor **during the** third battle of Panipat** was **Shahalam II.**
 
• The battle took place on **14th January 1761** between the **Marathas and the Afghans **led by** Ahmad Shah Durrani.**
 
• The** Marathas were defeated **in the battle which resulted in a huge loss of life and property.
 
• Shahalam II was the** son of Alamgir II** and the grandson of **Jahandar Shah.**
 
• He became the** Mughal emperor in 1759 **after the death of his father.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Akbar II **was the son of **Shah Alam II** and became the **Mughal emperor** after his father's death in **1806.**

 
 
• He was the** last of the Mughal emperors** to have any real power.
 
 
 
• **Bahadur Shah I** was the** Mughal emperor **who ruled from **1707 to 1712.**
 
 
• He was the** son of Aurangzeb** and was known for his **military campaigns in the Deccan.**
 
 
 
• **Bahadur Shah Zafar** was the **last Mughal emperor** who ruled from **1837 to 1857.**
 
 
• He was appointed as the emperor by the** Sayyid brothers** and was known for his weak rule.

questions.question: According to Koeppen's Scheme, which type of climate is denoted by the letter 'E' in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Polar type.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Koeppen's scheme** is a classification system for climates based on **temperature, precipitation and vegetation.**
 
• It was developed by** Wladimir Kundefinedppen,** a German botanist, in the early 20th century.
 
• The letter** 'E'** in Koeppen's scheme denotes **polar type climate,** which is characterized by **extremely low temperatures and dry conditions.**
 
• This type of climate is found in the **high latitudes near the poles**, such as in Antarctica and Greenland.
 
• India** does not **have a polar type climate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tropical savannah** is denoted by the letter **'Aw' in Koeppen's scheme.**

 
 
• This type of climate is characterized by **distinct wet and dry seasons, **with most of the** precipitation** occurring in the summer.
 
 
 
• **Hot desert** is denoted by the letter** 'BWh' in Koeppen's scheme**.
 
 
• This type of climate is characterized by **hot temperatures and very low precipitation.**
 
 
 
• **Monsoon with dry summer**, is denoted by the letter **'Am'** in Koeppen's scheme.
 
 
• This type of climate is found in India and is characterized by a **wet summer and a dry winter.**

questions.question: When did Carl Friedrich Gauss and Wilhelm Eduard Weber invent the world's first electromagnetic telegraph?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1833.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Carl Friedrich Gauss** and **Wilhelm Eduard Weber** invented the **world's first electromagnetic telegraph** in **1833.**
 
• The telegraph was capable of** transmitting signals **over long distances using **electricity and magnetism.**
 
• Gauss and Weber's invention paved the way for **modern communication systems,** including the internet.
 
• Gauss was a **renowned mathematician and physicist**, known for his contributions to **number theory, astronomy, and geodesy.**
 
• Weber was a** physicist **who worked closely with Gauss and made significant contributions to the** study of electricity and magnetism.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** electromagnetic force** that exists between **electrically charged particles **is the subject of the branch of physics known as **electromagnetism.**
 
• One of the four **fundamental forces**, the electromagnetic force, manifests electromagnetic fields like** magnetic fields, electric fields, and light. **
 
• In interactions between atoms and molecules, it is the **dominant force.**

questions.question: Who among the following was one of the founders of Rahnumai Mazdayasnan Sabha or Religious Reform Association?

• The founders of the association were mainly **Parsi intellectuals** who were influenced by the ideas of the **Indian Renaissance **and the** reform movements** in other religions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Aatmarang Pandurang **was a **Marathi social reformer **who fought against **caste discrimination** and for** women's rights.**

questions.question: Which of the following periods is known as the period of population explosion in India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1951 - 1981.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The period of **population explosion** in India is from **1951-1981.** 
 
• During this time, India's population grew at an** unprecedented rate** of **2.2% per year.**
 
• The population explosion was due to a combination of factors such as** improvements in healthcare, increased food production, and a decrease in infant mortality rates.**
 
• This period also saw the implementation of **family planning programs** in India to control population growth.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1931-1961** saw a **moderate population growth rate **in India due to a decrease in mortality rates and improvements in healthcare.
 
• **1921-1951** saw a **decrease in India's population growth **rate due to famines and epidemics.
 
• Increases in a population's or a dispersed group's size are known as** population growth.**
 
• The actual annual increase in the human population is about** 83 million, or 1.1%**.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT one of the scenarios of National Digital Education Architecture (NDEAR) launched by the Government of India in 2021?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Develop Learn.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Digital Education Architecture (NDEAR)** is a program launched by the **Government of India in 2021** to provide a** digital infrastructure** for education in the country.
 
• **Manage Learn:** This scenario aims to provide a platform for **educators and learners** to manage their learning activities.
 
 
• It includes features such as** course management, assessment tools, and analytics.**
 
 
 
• **Learn: **This scenario focuses on providing **access to digital resources** for learners.
 
 
• It includes **e-books, videos, and interactive learning modules.**
 
 
 
• **Help Learn: **This scenario aims to provide support to learners through **online forums, chatbots, and other online resources.**
 
• Develop Learn is** not **one of the scenarios of NDEAR.
 
• The other options are all part of the program and aim to provide a** digital infrastructure **for education in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Together with the **Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, **it is managed by the** Ministry of Education**.
 
• According to this, the government will act as an **enabler, providing a framework **so that technology can be developed and built by anyone instead of developing technology solutions for the education sector.
 
• The institutional **design, timeline, governance model, and technology **of NDEAR will be advantageous to the teacher community as well as students.
 
• **NDEAR-compliant solutions **would follow the NDEAR frameworks and standards.
 
• Solutions that are NDEAR-compliant would be able to** communicate** with one another.
 
• The framework suggests that **solutions and systems** that were successful in one state could be applied to other parts of the nation.

questions.question: Which form of leucoplast specialises in oil synthesis and storage and is mainly found in the layer of cells in pollen grains that develop pollen grains?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Elaioplasts.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Elaioplasts** are a type of** leucoplasts **that specialize in **oil synthesis and storage.**
 
• They are mainly found in the** layer of cells** in **pollen grains** that develop pollen grains.
 
• Elaioplasts are also found in the** seeds of plants** and are responsible for** storing oils and fats.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gerontoplasts **are the type of plastids that are formed from** chloroplasts **during the process of senescence (aging) of the plant cell.
 
• **Proteinoplasts **are the type of plastids that are involved in the **synthesis and storage of proteins.**
 
• **Chloroplasts **are the type of plastids that are responsible for** photosynthesis** in plant cells.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the State Executive?

A. Article 152 of the Indian Constitution states 'Unless the context otherwise requires, the expression 'State' does not include Jammu and Kashmir'.

B. The 7th Constitutional Amendment Act has provided for the appointment of the same person as Governor for two or more states.

C. The Supreme Court clearly mentioned that the office of the Governor is under the control of the Central Government.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**A and B only.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 152** of the Indian Constitution states 'Unless the context otherwise requires, the expression **'State' **does not include **Jammu and Kashmir**'.

 
 
• This statement is **correct.**
 
• It means that unless the context requires otherwise, the** laws and provisions** applicable to other states in India do not apply to Jammu and Kashmir.
 
 
 
• The **7th Constitutional Amendment Act** has provided for the appointment of the same person as **Governor** for **two or more states**.
 
 
• This statement is **correct.**
 
• The 7th Constitutional Amendment Act, **1956**, allowed the appointment of the same person as **Governor** for** two or more states** to promote better coordination between the states.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Supreme Court clearly mentioned that the **office of the Governor** is under the **control of the Central Government.**

 
 
• This statement is** incorrect.**
 
• The Supreme Court has held that the** Governor's office** is not under the control of the Central Government.
 
• However, the Governor is bound to act on the** aid and advice **of the **Council of Ministers of the State.**
 
 
 
• The **State Executive** comprises the** Governor, Chief Minister, Council of Ministers, and Advocate General.**

questions.question: The 'East-West' corridor connects which of the following cities?

The correct answer is __**Silchar and Porbandar. **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **'East-West'** corridor is a major highway project undertaken by the Indian government to connect the** eastern and western regions** of the country.
 
• It is also known as **National Highway 27 (NH-27).**
 
• The corridor starts from **Porbandar in Gujarat **and ends at **Silchar in Assam,** covering a distance of around **3,400 km.**
 
• It passes through several major cities and towns, including** Ahmedabad, Udaipur, Ajmer, Jaipur, Agra, Kanpur, Guwahati, and Shillong.**
 
• The 'East-West' corridor is an important infrastructure project that aims to** promote economic growth and development** in the regions it connects.
 
• It is expected to **improve connectivity, reduce travel time,** and boost **trade and commerce.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Itanagar** is the **capital city** of **Arunachal Pradesh**, located in the **northeastern region** of India, while **Dwarka** is a city in** Gujarat,** located in the western region of India.

 
 
• These two cities are** not connected** by the 'East-West' corridor.
 
 
 
• While both** Guwahati and Gandhinagar **are connected by** NH-27**, they are not the endpoints of the 'East-West' corridor.
 
 
• Moreover, Gandhinagar is **not even l**ocated on the eastern or western coast of India.
 
 
 
• While **Shillong** is located on** NH-27** and is connected to several other cities on the corridor, **Kandla** is a **port town** in **Gujarat** that is not directly connected to the 'East-West' corridor.

questions.question: The feature of fundamental duties in the Indian Constitution is adopted from which of the following countries?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Soviet Union (USSR).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** feature of fundamental duties** in the Indian Constitution is adopted from the **Soviet Union (USSR).**
 
• The idea of fundamental duties was added to the Indian Constitution in **1976** through the **42nd amendment,** which was inspired by the Soviet Union's Constitution.
 
• The USSR's Constitution had a section on** fundamental duties **that emphasized the **responsibilities of citizens **towards the state and society.
 
• The fundamental duties in the Indian Constitution include **respecting the national flag and anthem, promoting harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood, **and **safeguarding public property and natural resources.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The UK** does not **have fundamental duties in its Constitution, although it does have a** set of laws and conventions** that outline the responsibilities of citizens towards the **state and society.**
 
• **Germany **has a set of **fundamental rights and duties **in its Constitution, but these are focused on protecting individual rights rather than emphasizing the **responsibilities of citizens** towards the state and society.
 
• The US Constitution **does not have** a section on fundamental duties, although it does outline the rights and responsibilities of citizens in various amendments.

questions.question: The Nehru trophy boat race was organised by which of the following states?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Nehru Trophy Boat Race** is an annual event held in the** Punnamada Lake** in **Alappuzha district of Kerala.**
 
• The race was first held in **1952 **to commemorate a visit by India's first Prime Minister, **Jawaharlal Nehru**, to the state.
 
• The event attracts thousands of visitors from all over the world and features traditional **snake boats** (Chundan Vallam) competing against each other.
 
• The boats are rowed by more than a** hundred oarsmen** and the race is a spectacular display of **speed, agility, and teamwork.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Karnataka** is a state in South India that is known for its rich **cultural heritage and natural beauty. ****​**

• **Tamil Nadu** is another state in South India that is famous for its** temples, beaches, and cuisine.**
 
 
• **​**The **colonial Fort St. George** from **1644** is one of the landmarks in the capital city of **Chennai.**
 
 
 
• **West Bengal **is a state in eastern India that is known for its rich** history, culture, and literature.**

questions.question: As mentioned in the Government of India's Economic Survey 2022-23, Aadhaar is an essential tool for social delivery of how many Central Schemes as notified under Section 7 of the Aadhaar Act, 2016?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** 318.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As per the** Economic Survey 2022-23,** Aadhaar is an essential tool for **social delivery of 318 Central Schemes** as notified under Section 7 of the Aadhaar Act, 2016.
 
• This means that these schemes require **Aadhaar authentication** for availing their benefits.
 
• Aadhaar has become an important tool for the government to ensure the effective implementation of various** welfare schemes **and to prevent **leakages and duplication of beneficiaries.**
 
• Some of the Central Schemes that require Aadhaar authentication include **Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana, Atal Pension Yojana, Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana, and MGNREGA, among others.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Aadhaar Act, 2016 **is an Act of Parliament of India that provides for the establishment of the **Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI)** and assigns it the task of issuing Aadhaar cards.
 
• Aadhaar is a **12-digit unique identification number **that is issued to Indian citizens by the UIDAI based on their** biometric and demographic data**.
